stories.title: Define the modular runtime kernel boundary for kestrel-sovereign
stories.description: Implement issue #416. Add the canonical modular-runtime kernel boundary doc and a small module contract test scaffold so later extraction work has a stable target.

stories.title: Introduce stable module descriptors above feature discovery
stories.description: Implement issue #414. Add a stable module descriptor layer above current feature discovery so the runtime can reason about modules by stable id and declared contracts rather than class-name assumptions.

stories.title: Extract feature-specific startup wiring out of KestrelAgent.initialize()
stories.description: Implement issue #415. Move named-feature startup wiring behind generic lifecycle hooks or runtime bootstrap helpers while preserving current behavior for spawn, security, reflection, and schedule setup.

stories.title: Split portable state fragments from runtime behavior using legal personhood as a proving ground
stories.description: Implement issue #418. Define module-owned portable state fragments and use the legal/incorporation path as the first serious extraction without losing identity continuity or Wyoming DAO support.

stories.title: Move toward capability-mounted routers and enforce modular seams with tests
stories.description: Implement issue #417. Make at least one router more capability-owned and add seam tests that catch regressions toward monolithic coupling.
